title: rosa gallica f. atropurpurea
intro: Rosa gallica f. atropurpurea, commonly known as the 'Purple Gallant' or 'French Purple Rose', is a fragrant, dark purple-flowered cultivar of the Gallica rose species. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including reducing inflammation and soothing digestive issues, due to its health benefits of being an anti-inflammatory and carminative agent. The therapeutic actions of Rosa gallica f. atropurpurea include acting as a nervine, sedative, and antispasmodic, which can help alleviate anxiety, insomnia, and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its therapeutic properties and health benefits.
